jana_oncall: FYI our daily scan found ~60 backup objects missing 'encryption-context' and 'snapshot-origin' headers in us-east-1.

rob_backup: Which writer? multipart compose path?

jana_oncall: Yes, backup-worker compose flow. Timestamps cluster around 2026-03-22T02:10-02:20Z.

li_kms: KMS logs show short-lived grants (ttl=300s) issued to backup-worker and a spike of STS token rotations at 02:12. Possible grant expiry during finalize.

sam_infra: We also rolled role scoping change for backup-worker at 02:05 (PR #3389). Could be missing permissions for metadata merge on rewrite.

rob_backup: Quick mitigation: disable aggressive GC of grants and issue a 1h remediation grant for the remediation SA. I'll prepare script to rewrite metadata using manifest.

li_kms: I'll provision per-tenant grants and log them. Ensure remediation principal has kms:Encrypt and s3:PutObject for relevant buckets.

repair-bot: Remediation job queued: repair-5612400005-dryrun.

jana_oncall: Dry-run shows 60 candidates, 48 with manifest entries. 12 need manual investigation.

sam_infra: Add alert: >5 finalized objects without encryption-context in 15m -> page eng-security. Also revert the role scoping bug in next patch if confirmed.

rob_backup: Live rewrite scheduled in 20m using same CMKs; will tag repaired objects with x-amz-meta-repaired-by=encops-2026-03-22.

li_kms: After remediation, we'll change grant strategy: extend TTL for finalize-prone operations or refresh grant on finalize call.

jana_oncall: Thanks. Keep updates brief here; escalate any tenant restores that fail.
